text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Observability: error-rate spike detected for /v1/generate (5m window). 500/502 count up 9x baseline. P95 latency +2.3x. Triggering PAGER to oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: release=v3.14.2 canary=20% flag=new-tokenizer target=canary-us-east-1. Canary started 2026-03-15T14:10:40Z.

Maria G: I'm on it (oncall). Paging via PD. Anyone see recent infra changes?

Rahul P: We just shipped a tokenizer kernel change in the canary image that switches to a quantized path for some model shims. Telemetry shows increased kernel timeouts in that canary pool. 502s look like upstream runtime failing to init.

Tom K: Noted. Customer impact? Which tenants hit?

Rahul P: Mostly small bursty tenants on canary slice — ~120 distinct calls failing, not global yet. A handful of mid-tier customers saw degraded responses. No data exfiltration signs.

Maria G: OK. Two mitigation options: 1) disable feature flag 'new-tokenizer' (kill-switch) to route to stable path; 2) manual rollback of canary to previous image. Kill-switch is fast. I prefer flag off first. Thoughts?

Tom K: +1 flag off. Less blast radius. If flag flip doesn't heal in 2 min, do canary rollback.

Sarah L: I can flip flag from Console. Quick command if needed: 

```bash
# toggle via management API
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/flags/new-tokenizer/toggle \
  -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

Maria G: Doing the flag-off now. Executing the curl (using ops-admin token).

Maria G: curl returned 200, payload: {"flag":"new-tokenizer","enabled":false,"changed_by":"maria.g","ts":"2026-03-15T14:12:08Z"} :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Feature flag change observed. Propagating to canary pools.

ops-bot: Rolling config push to 20 canary nodes in us-east-1. Expected propagation 30-60s.

Rahul P: Watching metrics... error-rate dropping in canary slice. P95 latency trending down.

Tom K: Can we run a quick canary smokecheck? curl a few sample endpoints that previously failed.

ops-bot: Running smokecheck script: `scripts/smoke/canary_check.sh --targets canary-us-east-1`

ops-bot: Smokecheck results: 12/12 endpoints OK, average latency 120ms, 0x 5xx observed.

Maria G: Confirming: customer error-reports in slack decreased. I'm going to keep monitoring for 15m. If stable, we leave flag off and halt rollout.

Sarah L: I'm creating a rollback ticket for the canary rollout (so we don't accidentally resume): https://redwood/tracker/TCK-4521 (DO NOT RESUME).

Tom K: Good. Also add a note to block automatic rollout retry in deployment config.

Rahul P: Root cause hypothesis: quantized-tokenizer path has a race in kernel init when memory allocator hits a fragmentation edge-case. We'll reproduce in staging with a stress harness.

Maria G: Handoff: I'm about to go AFK for 10 mins, Rahul — can you take watch? I'll still have phone.

Rahul P: Taking watch. Ping me if recovery regresses.

Maria G: Thanks. Postmortem owners: Rahul (root cause & fix), Sarah (rollback playbook & flag safety checks), Tom (deployment guardrails).

ops-bot: Noted owners. Incident severity: Sev2 -> mitigated by flag toggle. Logging this as "feature-flag mitigation, canary degradation".

Maria G: I'll mark this thread as done once we've been stable for 15m with no regressions. Current timeline: flag off at 14:12:08Z, mitigation confirmed 14:13:40Z.

Tom K: Add customer impact summary for postmortem: ~120 failed calls across 18 tenants, 7 customer support tickets opened, no billed data loss.

Sarah L: I'll draft the postmortem and include the smokecheck commands + remediation plan (temporarily pin to stable tokenizer, add allocator guard, add unit tests).

Maria G: Thanks team. Leaving monitoring with Rahul. :thumbsup:

Rahul P: All quiet for the last 8 minutes, metrics stable. I'll keep watch for the remainder of the window.

incident-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff in 50 minutes.

Maria G: Acknowledged. Back to full duty in ~10. Closing thread once 15m holds.

ops-bot: Closing notes: toggle audit logged, canary rollout halted, follow-up tasks created.

Maria G: Closing — leaving final tags: incident:canary-degradation, mitigation:flag-toggle, owner:rahul.p, severity:sev2.

Sarah L: thanks everyone :heart:
